name: seo-topic-planner
description: Evidence-led SEO topic research: keyword discovery and SERP-overlap clustering on DataForSEO, real reading of ranking pages, a verified content-gap analysis, and page outlines built around a proven information gain.

interface.longDescription: Turns a website, its ICP and a business goal into researched page plans. Discovers keywords from seeds, competitors and the client's own rankings; clusters them by shared Google results; reads the pages that rank; checks every coverage claim against the captured text; scores each content gap by its evidence; and outlines pages whose sections are either table stakes or a proven information gain — with concrete tasks for what the client must supply. Spending stays inside the budget the user approves.
defaultPrompt: Research SEO topics for my website and tell me which pages to create or update, with the evidence.
Find the information gain my site can offer on a topic and outline the page.
Estimate the research cost first, then run the keyword and competitor research.
